correctness.rationale: The two branch equations imply equality of both coordinate means with the mean branch signal. Centered second-moment stationarity gives two exact covariance equations, and Cauchy--Schwarz factors into the two claimed variance corridors. Equality cases were reconstructed: an upper equality forces branch persistence and corner support, while a lower equality forces zero branch mean, deterministic branch alternation, and the explicit two-cycle subject to the branch-admissibility inequality. Degenerate branch variance gives only the two corner Dirac measures. Exact symbolic replay returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Branch occupation is the natural symbolic statistic of this piecewise-hyperbolic map. Converting it exactly into both coordinate means and two sharp variance envelopes gives a structural constraint on every invariant state. The equality classifications identify the two extremal dynamical mechanisms--persistent branch fixed points and perfect alternating branches--so the result is more than a normalization check or isolated moment computation and supplies exact diagnostics for invariant-measure studies.
